propositions: GitHub-hosted dependabot PRs #123 and #124 cannot merge to main and must be re-landed as Gerrit changes; the PRs must then be closed by hand.
PR #123 bumps actions/setup-python from v6 to v7 across 13 workflow files; PR #124 bumps mcp from 1.29.0 to 2.0.0 (major version) and ruff from 0.15.22 to 0.16.1.

mcp 2.0.0 is a breaking change that may remove compat shims for v1 API paths (FastMCP, auth.settings, transport_security, ToolAnnotations) imported by rebar-mcp; the test suite must validate whether 2.0 retains these paths or if migration work is deferred.
A P0 security vulnerability in click 8.2.1 (PYSEC-2026-2132, command injection) blocks all CI Verified runs via the pip-audit gate; click must be bumped to >=8.3.3 in uv.lock first.
Two out-of-pyproject.toml consumers of the mcp version constraint exist and must be kept coherent: .github/workflows/_optionality.yml and the ADR 0050 documenting the pin rationale.
